extension-point.name: openSearchIndex
extension-point.documentation:
Extension point used to setup an OpenSearch index.
The one used to index OpenArch documents must be of type "doc".
sys_* sys_binaryFulltext
@Since 5.9.3 name is the OpenSearch index name.
type is the OpenSearch type that hold a mapping, "doc" is the mapping for OpenArch documents
create can be set to false if you don't want OpenArch to initialize the index and mapping.
settings the OpenSearch settings @see http://www.opensearch.org/guide/en/opensearch/reference/current/index-modules.html
mapping the OpenSearch mapping for the type @see http://www.opensearch.org/guide/en/opensearch/reference/current/mapping.html
@Since 5.9.5 fetchFromSources, include a list of field name pattern that will be included when fetching document from OpenSearch (@see NxQueryBuilder.fetchFromOpenSearch) use the exclude list to prevent returning fulltext or long fields.

extension-point.name: embeddingsParser
extension-point.documentation:
Extension point to contribute ONE EmbeddingsParser implementation.
Current rules (simplified): - 0 active contributions -> internal NOOP fallback (no embeddings indexed, no error). - 1 active contribution -> used. - >1 active contributions -> startup error (ambiguity not supported yet).
Attributes: - class (required): implementation class - enabled (optional, default=true): enable/disable the contribution
Example:
Tests may disable a default contribution (enabled="false") and add another to inject a mock.
@Since 2025.0
